formula_neutral_counterpart: Remove H+ from a singly positive formula; add H+ to a singly negative formula. Impossible negative H count is excluded. Canonical Hill text exact match; frozen tier (150.00001725..1249.99949137 Da) and explicit window 157..1159 counted separately.
small_fragment_range: The tier starts at 150 Da. A missing counterpart below 150 is outside this resource, not proof of absence from PubChem.
structure_neutral_counterpart: Capped atom-connected pieces of the known structure after <=3 bond removals, H-saturated to neutral closed shell; exact IK14 lookup. No tautomer or full PubChem standardisation performed.
weighting: Primary fixed spectrum-stratified sample only for population summaries. Each primary spectrum has eligible-stratum-population / sampled-stratum-size weight. Graph/absence supplements excluded. All frequencies label raw and population-weighted fractions.
neutral_loss: Precursor/product differences and best-formula-compatible product/product differences. Neither is a measured sequential MSn edge. Fragment formulas may have multiple assignments; names are tentative.
radical: Odd total-electron parity of a neutral-loss formula from an even-electron precursor; denominator limited to peaks whose every compatible formula has the same electron parity. Does not detect electronic state or distinguish all radical mechanisms.
ion_formula_order: Stored annotation formulas use explicit element order; catalogue queries canonicalise to Hill order before exact equality.
